name: google-mail-mcp
description: Gmail over MCP from your own account: search, read threads and messages, labels and drafts.
long_description:
Search and read Gmail from your own account, with mail content marked as untrusted data rather than instructions. Drafts are the default write, removal is trash, and sending, permanent deletion and settings changes are not offered unless you turn them on.

THIS BUNDLE DOES NOT LOG YOU IN, and cannot. Google requires each user to bring their own OAuth Desktop client, so before the tools work you need to create one in a Google Cloud project, enable the Gmail API, and run `google-mail-mcp login` once from a terminal. The setup is documented at https://github.com/mmedum/google-mail-mcp/blob/main/docs/gcp-setup.md. Without that step the server starts, lists its tools, and answers every call with "not signed in".

client_secret.title: OAuth client JSON
client_secret.description: The OAuth Desktop client you created in your own Google Cloud project, the file you passed to `google-mail-mcp login`. Leave it empty to use the one that login stored for the profile. You still need to run `google-mail-mcp login` once from a terminal.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Which stored login to use. Each profile keeps its own client, token and account, such as a work account and a personal one, and each is logged in to with `google-mail-mcp login --profile <name>`. A name is up to 64 characters from a to z, 0 to 9, - and _, starting with a letter or digit; A to Z are read as a to z, and any other name stops the server at start. Leave it empty for the default profile.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Register only the read tools and ask Google for gmail.readonly, so the API itself refuses a write. It cannot be combined with Allow sending, Allow permanent deletion or Allow settings changes: the server then refuses to start.

enable_send.title: Allow sending
enable_send.description: Register the tool that sends a draft. Without it this server cannot send mail. Off by default, and not with Read-only. The token can send either way, so keep it in the keyring. This server asks nobody before a call, so Claude Desktop's approval of each tool is then the only check.

enable_destructive.title: Allow permanent deletion
enable_destructive.description: Register permanent deletion, and, with settings changes allowed too, deleting filters and filters that trash mail. It asks Google for full mail access, needs a new login, and every call still has to confirm. Off by default, and not with Read-only. Removal is trash.

enable_settings.title: Allow settings changes
enable_settings.description: Register setting a signature and creating filters, which cannot forward or trash. With permanent deletion allowed too, also deleting filters and filters that trash mail; with sending allowed too, the vacation reply, for contacts or your domain only. It asks Google for gmail.settings.basic and needs a new login. Off by default, and not with Read-only.

local_dir.title: Attachment folder
local_dir.description: The one folder attachments are saved to and read from. Leave it empty and this server touches no files.
